result:
Longest recent run in Running history now shows the larger of what was entered and your longest completed run, and it drops back when you untick a run. All the tests pass on temporary copies of the project, and the real database and the login and signup templates are untouched. No database change is needed, because the value is worked out each time the page loads.

**There was no label to remove:** "Entered in your plans" doesn't appear anywhere in this app's code, templates, styles or README. If you saw it, it may have been in the `feature_build` version, or you may mean the Longest recent run row itself. Tell me where you saw it and I'll take another look.

**What I tested** (with 12 km entered):

| Situation | Longest recent run |
|---|---|
| Nothing completed | 12 km |
| A 5 km run completed | 12 km |
| A 17.5 km run completed | 17.5 km |
| That run unticked, on its own page or the calendar | Back to 12 km |

It also follows the week checkbox and edits to a completed run's distance. The number you entered on the plan isn't changed, so the plan's summary still shows the original. With nothing entered, it just follows your completed runs, and the section goes back to "Nothing here yet." if there's nothing at all.

**Things to know**
- **The race counts:** the race day run is a completed run like any other, so ticking a half marathon's race makes this show 21.1 km. It works the same way as Longest completed run. If you'd rather only count training runs, it's a small change.
- **It can repeat the row below:** when a completed run is the longest, this row shows the same number as Longest completed run.
- **It covers all your plans:** archived plans count too. Deleting a plan removes what it contributed, and editing a plan removes its completed runs from the count.

**Files changed:** `main.py`, one calculation in `running_history()`. One older test expected the entered value even with a longer completed run, so I updated it to the new behaviour.
